steps.stdout:
Command-line client for Kaneo

Usage:
  kaneo [command]

Available Commands:
  activity     Read and record a task's history
  api-check    Check this client's operations against the server's OpenAPI document
  board        Show open tasks and the sessions working on them
  column       Work with a project's columns
  comment      Work with task comments
  completion   Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  context      Show the resolved settings and where each value came from
  help         Help about any command
  invitation   Look up invitations to workspaces
  label        Work with labels
  notification Work with your notifications
  project      Work with projects
  search       Search a workspace's tasks, projects, comments and activities
  session      Tie the current agent session to a task
  task         Work with tasks
  time         Track time spent on tasks
  whoami       Verify the configured API key and show what it can reach
  workflow     Work with a project's integration rules
  workspace    Work with workspaces

Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
  -h, --help               help for kaneo
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --jq string          filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --json)
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id, slug or name (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   per-request timeout (default 10s)
  -v, --version            version for kaneo
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id, slug or name (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)

Use "kaneo [command] --help" for more information about a command.
